message: The other day, I decided to try my hand at a new recipe that involved a lot of flames—let’s just say the smoke alarm was not amused! 😅 Between the smoke and my frantic dance to open windows, I realized I hadn't even thought about our escape plan. It’s funny how we can be so focused on cooking that we forget the basics. A little reminder to keep safety in mind, even when you're just whipping up dinner! What’s your go-to kitchen safety tip?
